# 1. Access record and confirmation

**Participant:** ⟦PERSON|Evrissa Nolven⟧

**Records provider:** ⟦ORG|Pale Loom Records Ltd⟧ (the Provider)

1.1 The participant may inspect the deposited records during the agreed appointment. Inspection includes reading the index and checking that the listed pages are present. It does not include removal of originals or alteration of an annotation on a source page.

1.2 The personal access identifier is **Access ID:** ⟦IDENTITY|RV#842176⟧. The hash is an internal character in the identifier printed on the access card. The identifier must not be shortened to its final digits when preparing the attendance record.
